settings.credential: Speaker and author · 1M+ views with Malte Marten
settings.relation: Leander Greitemann is a German Speaker, Author and Handpan Player/Teacher. His life has always been filled with music, but when he discovered the Handpan in 2020, he knew something was different. Never had he played an instrument with so much passion and joy. Jamming with others, composing melodies, improvising songs, teaching his insights and giving concerts.
settings.quote: I first played an Ayasa, when I met Malte Marten for the first time in 2021. I had the honour to jam with him on his Ayasa C# Pygmy 17 and F#2 Pygmy 16. After that I knew I HAD to have one for myself. Luckily, later that year, Alexander Mercks sold me his Ayasa C# Pygmy 17 and it's such a special treasure for me
settings.relation_more:
His career came to another level, when his Studio Session with Malte Marten went viral in 2023, cracking the 1 million views barrier easily. His opening melody in this video (in the song "To the Stars") is renowned all over the world. He has recorded a solo studio album (When the Bluebird sings) and keeps on working with other artists to share his passion for this beautiful instrument in many different ways.
